profile.publication: OPFS immutable byte objects + IndexedDB atomic logical-name/outcome transaction
profile.nativeUserFilenameSemantics: explicitly unsupported; logical catalogue names only
profile.filesystemWrites: real OPFS native writable stream: positioned write + truncate + close
profile.recovery: persisted outcome inspection in the live namespace; no crash/restart adoption
profile.retention: committed objects and attempt tombstones retained; explicit failed-attempt cleanup only

scenarios: cross-tab create-new race has one winner
fresh successful retry after each interruption
zero native API lifetime counters after teardown

verificationTransport.otherFiles: 64KiB chunks through test driver; browser/Node SHA-256 agreement
verificationTransport.earlierTimeout: Firefox download event timeout after successful export/commit/hash/resource checks; cause not established; no bulk download UI claim
verificationTransport.timing: integer decoded PTS/timebase for long files; avoids FFmpeg pts_time text precision loss

limitations: Not Downloads or user-picked native filenames; no native file exclusive-create/replace certification.
No cross-store crash/power-loss/fsync durability or storage eviction guarantee.
No hostile same-origin mutation protection; private namespace/schema ownership required.
No public retention/GC API or persistent quota; committed versions/tombstones cost storage.
API resource lifetime counts are not OS descriptor/RSS/GC/cache measurements; harness full-file hashing is not a streaming-memory benchmark.
Browser receiver matrix executed locally on Windows Chromium/Firefox; it is not part of the existing CI browser jobs.
No public external API/P27/P28, version/tag/release/npm in this stage; commit/push and existing CI verification are separate delivery steps.
next: Review user-visible save and retention/recovery profile separately before public external entries; do not start next stage automatically.
